notes.title: Heading Home 2.0
notes.notes:
Heading Home [u][b]2.0[/b][/u] Version :

[u][b]Reworked Shadows completely[/b][/u] : Shadows were reworked from ground up. Better performance and less aggressive shadows distance.

[u][b]Added missing collisions :[/b][/u] Underwater rocks have now proper collisions.

[u][b]Ice-cream collectables goals : [/b][/u] Ice-creams have now a real purpose in the game, collect them to be able to unlock areas!

[u][b]NPC Enemy Reworked : [/b][/u] Enemy will now pursue you on a much longer distance, and will be sent flying upon dying. No more Jelly-ish death in place.

[b][u]Magic rocks : [/u][/b] You can now access new areas by standing on the magic rocks, they will move towards new places to discovers. Be careful some rocks need to be activated by a pressure plate, look around the area to find them.

Minor tweak to improve overall performance.
